notes.title: Update Now Available! (Build Number: 4129888)
notes.content:
We have released a new version of London Detective Mysteria that addresses a bug with choices in Chapter 7.

Build Number: 4129888

Bug fixes:
-Selecting "What if the corpse had something contagious?" no longer prevents the player from progressing

This same issue is present in the GOG release of the game, and we are working on a fix presently. We appreciate your patience while we work on this.
